source: The message panel must share a split with the message list. Not saved yet.
text: Ogwe ozi ga-ekekọrịta nkewa na ndepụta ozi. Echekwabeghị.

source: Not sent: these addresses contain characters SMTP cannot carry: %1$s
text: ezipughi: adreesị ndị a nwere mkpụrụedemede SMTP enweghị ike ibu: %1$s

source.one: %1$d existing contact has a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?
source.other: %1$d existing contacts have a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?

text.other: Ndị kọntaktị %1$d dị nwere aha, aha njirimara ma ọ bụ ndetu dị iche. A na-agbakwụnye naanị adreesị. Degharịa ụkpụrụ dị iche iche, ma ọ bụ dowe ndị dị adị wee jupụta naanị oghere efu?

source: Host, host:port, or an https (or http) URL. The JMAP service is found at https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; the port is 443 unless given.
text: Onye ọbịa, onye ọbịa: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri, ma ọ bụ https (ma ọ bụ http) URL. A na-ahụ ọrụ JMAP na https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri bụ 443 ọ gwụla ma enyere ya.

source: Plain http: your password and mail travel unencrypted.
text: Plain http: paswọọdụ gị na njem mail ezoghị ezo.

source: This account cannot send: set an SMTP server or turn on Send over JMAP.
text: Akaụntụ a enweghị ike izipu: tọọ ihe nkesa SMTP ma ọ bụ gbanye Zipụ JMAP.

text: Cyrus SASL, ikike Mahadum Carnegie Mellon

source: Saves the current expansion as the default.
text: Na-echekwa mgbasawanye ugbu a dị ka ndabara.

source: Opens messages kept on this device.
text: Mepee ozi echekwara na ngwaọrụ a.

source: Chooses which actions stay on the bar.
text: Họrọ omume ndị ga-anọ na mmanya.
Nke a na nchekwa na-amalite gbasaa.

source: Selects every message in the list.
text: Na-ahọpụta ozi ọ bụla dị na listi ahụ.

source: Marks the messages in this folder read.
text: Kaa akara ozi ndị dị na folda a na-agụ.

source: Shows the thread of the selected message.
Saves the message without deleting it.
Copies an address from the message.
text: Detuo adreesị site na ozi ahụ.

source: Starts a filter from this message.
text: Na-amalite nzacha site na ozi a.

source: Shows the message with dark colors.
text: Na-egosi ozi ahụ nwere agba gbara ọchịchịrị.

source: Shows the message with its own colors.
text: Na-egosi ozi na agba nke ya.
Gbochie onyonyo sitere na onye zitere a.
Na-enye ohere onyonyo sitere na onye zitere ya.
Gbochie onyonyo site na ndepụta a.
Na-enye ohere onyonyo sitere na ndepụta a.
Azịza nye onye ọ bụla nnata.

source: Saves the message to send later.
text: Na-echekwa ozi iji zipu ma emechaa.
Kaa ozi ahụ dị ka spam.
Na-egosi nkụnye eji isi mee ọ bụla.

source: Adds or removes this folder as a favorite.
text: Na-agbakwụnye ma ọ bụ wepụ folda a dị ka ọkacha mmasị.

source: Shows the message in this view.

text: Na-eji adreesị a dị ka Site.

source: Uses this field in the query.
text: Na-eji mpaghara a na ajụjụ a.

source: Limits the list to this criterion.
text: Na-amachi ndepụta ahụ na ọkwa a.

source: Marks the selection seen or unseen.
text: Na-egosi nhọrọ a hụrụ ma ọ bụ ahụghị ya.
Ọkọlọtọ ma ọ bụ wepụ ọkọlọtọ nhọrọ.
